overview: CareConnect X is a premium AI-native healthcare web app that connects real health sensor data to live predictive care intelligence.
features: Real-time health metrics from Bluetooth devices and manual entry
Predictive Care Engine with live risk predictions based on real data
Standard medical thresholds for stress, sleep, BP, and emergency risk
Long-term health metric history stored in backend for trend detection
No fake data — only real readings or clearly labeled No data states
Dashboard manual entry for heart rate, blood pressure, and sleep
